headline: Linn Mercy Erupts Anew; Colonial Flag Returns to Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the last edition, fighting has returned in force to Linn Mercy, whose casualty ledger, cooled at the previous filing, now burns hot again: more than two thousand Warden and thirteen hundred Colonial losses in two hours, with Lathair and Outwich Ranch still trading flags. In the Weathered Expanse a Colonial flag has risen where the last edition counted only ruins, leaving six Warden posts, one Colonial post and two ruins, with Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest the busiest grounds. Transient Valley, briefly Warden on the Farranac Coast, has passed back to the Colonials. Palantine Berm's forty-seven-event seesaw stands four Colonial posts to three Warden but has been still since evening, as has the eight-post Warden Nevish Line. Stonecradle stirs, with seven events in two hours about The Dais and casualties climbing, while Breaker Town on the Stlican Shelf fell neutral and then Colonial. Checkpoint Bua still turns in Marban Hollow; the Gutter's late flurry has spent itself; Clahstra cools even as Callums Cape keeps a heavy toll without a flag moving. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; no victor is named.
